topic: Data processing architecture for regional analytics
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on the optimal data infrastructure, specifically concerning the need for a ClickHouse server in Brazil and regional processing. Concerns were raised about the necessity of a dedicated Brazilian server versus centralizing all data. A key point was the requirement for hourly recalculations (recalc) due to significant time zone differences. It was proposed that a solution involving small regional servers could be implemented, primarily for aggregation and real-time data handling. The participants discussed routing router data via MQTT directly to the center, bypassing local nodes.
decisions: Consideration of a regional structure for data processing in multiple regions.
action_items: Investigate if ClickHouse can function effectively without dedicated clusters in regional locations.
